tei:div.tei:ab: October 2: Beethoven Op. 31, No. 1, revisited. Bach-Brahms Chaconne for the left hand, new.
October 15: Beethoven Sonata Op. 31, No. 2, revisited.
November 6: Beethoven G major Concerto, already played many years earlier, yet as if new, first and second movements; Berceuse revisited.

November 20: Chopin Impromptu in C minor (for her pupils); Brahms Capriccio in B minor, new; Beethoven
Concerto, last movement.
December 4: Beethoven Sonata in F major, Op. 10, No. 2, revisited; Chopin Nocturne in E major Op. 9, No. 2, A major new.
January 8: Etudes Op. 25, the first volume.
February 19: Sonatas in C minor and F minor revisited.
April 2: Op. 53 to the end; revisited: Nocturnes Op. 9: No. 1 in B minor and No. 2 in E major, and the Berceuse.
April 16: Nocturnes in F major, B major, and E major.
May 7: Nocturnes in F major, B major, and F minor; Schubert Impromptu in A major, 3/4 time, new (for her pupils); Schubert G major Impromptu revisited.
June 9: Beethoven, Sonata Op. 81a, new, all movements; J. S. Bach’s Fugue in C minor from Book I revisited.

tei:div.tei:ab: 22. XII. Appassionata 1. Satz wiederholt;– op. 81a begonnen.Diary November 26: “From 6:45 to 8:30 Mr. und Mrs. Kaposi: the wife asks to have lessons, I make space for these every second and fourth Saturday.”
15. I. op.81a 1. Satz zuende, Appassionata 2. Satz wiederholt.
26. II. op. 81a, letzter Satz; wiederholt Brahms’ Rhapsodie,Probably the Rhapsody in B minor, Op. 79, No. 1, which Schenker taught frequently. Intermezzo Cd op. 118 119 , No 3.
25. Chopin Scherzo zuende.Diary June 22: “Make-up lessons: Mrs. Kaposi, to whom I announce the fee increase.”

tei:div.tei:ab: December 22 Appassionata, first movement revisited; – Op. 81a begun.
January 15 Op.81a, first movement finished, Appassionata, second movement revisited.
February 26 Op. 81a, last movement; revisiting of Brahms’s Rhapsody and Intermezzo in C major, Op. 119, No. 3.
June 11 Chopin Scherzo in B minor, new.
